# check/fail

> Helper: how check's statements report a failure and stop.

truck [check](../check.md) · [source](../../../registry/check/fail.pkg)

`check_fail(pos, what, detail)` writes `pos: what: detail` to stderr,
after flushing what `rt/io` buffered for stdout; `check_note` adds a
piece of the message (the first after `: `), and `check_stop` ends the
line and exits with status 2, like other runtime errors.

```
app.pkg:12:3: requirement failed: n > 0: the count must be positive
```

## Needs

- [std](../std.md)
- [rt/io](../rt/io.md)

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
global check_noted: bool = false

fn check_fail(pos: str, what: str, detail: str)
  check_noted = false
  io_err(pos)
  io_err(": ")
  io_err(what)
  if detail != ""
    io_err(": ")
    io_err(detail)
  end
end

fn check_note(m: str)
  if !check_noted
    io_err(": ")
    check_noted = true
  end
  io_err(m)
end

fn check_stop()
  io_err("\n")
  syscall(60, 2)
end
```
